panel.title: The dry fountain
panel.text: A stone fountain with a carved basin, dry for three summers. Hasan the mason taps the cracked pipe: “Sixty coins and it runs again. The children carry water up from the river now.”

done.title: Water again
done.text: Hasan opens the pipe. Water fills the basin and spills over the lip. By noon women are filling jars and children splash their faces.
done.named: Your name is cut into the stone.
